<a id="p5-limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism` — The underlying space of a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces is the inverse limit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (o))

*Theorem.* Let X = lim_i X_i be the limit of a cofiltered diagram of affinoid perfectoid spaces X_i = Spa(R_i, R_i⁺) (P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces). Then the map |X| → lim_i |X_i| induced by the projections is a homeomorphism of spectral spaces: lim_i |X_i| (inverse limit in topological spaces) is spectral, the projections |X| → |X_i| and the transition maps are spectral, and the map is a homeomorphism. Moreover every rational subset U ⊆ X equals p_i^{-1}(U_i) for some i and some rational subset U_i ⊆ X_i.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; X the limit of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces.

**Proof outline.**

1. Apply P5/spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs to the perfectoid pairs with rings of definition A_{i,0} = R_i⁺ (bounded because R_i is uniform, P1/perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras); its completion is (R, R⁺) (P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs), so Spa(R, R⁺) → lim Spa(R_i, R_i⁺) is a homeomorphism and rational subsets descend.
2. Spectrality of the limit and of the projections: DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces, with each |X_i| spectral and transition maps spectral (preimages of rational subsets are rational).

**Uses.**

- DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/pro-constructible-generalizing-subsets-are-affinoid: the underlying space of an intersection of rational subsets is the intersection
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/w-localization: |X^wl| = lim |T| over finite disjoint unions of rational subsets
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D6/spd-is-a-spatial-diamond: |Spa| of the completed tower is the limit of the |Spa(A_i, A_i⁺)|
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens: prerequisite of: Quasicompact opens and rational subsets of a cofiltered limit descend to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets: prerequisite of: Restriction of a cofiltered limit to a rational subset of a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes: prerequisite of: Base changes of a qcqs perfectoid space along a cofiltered limit form a limit, with spectral underlying spaces
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countably-generated-decomposition: prerequisite of: Every affinoid perfectoid space is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of topologically countably generated affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.5)

**Acceptance.**

- Profinite sets: |S × Spa(K, O_K)| = S × |Spa(K, O_K)|, with S carrying its profinite topology.
- ECD Example 5.2: |Spa(K(x), K(x)⁺)| = ⋂_{U ∋ x} U with the subspace topology, U ranging over rational neighbourhoods of x in X₀.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs`](#p5-spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs`](#p5-completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P1/perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras`](#p1-perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras), `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces`, [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/affinoid-perfectoid-space`](#p2-affinoid-perfectoid-space).

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, Proposition 6.4 (o), p. 27. The statement of part (o).
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4, p. 27. The proof route: completion (Huber) and the direct limit computation (Sch12 6.13(ii)).
- [`sch12-perfectoid`](#source-p0-sch12-perfectoid), Section 6, Lemma 6.13 (ii), p. 37. Descent of rational subsets.

<a id="p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces` — Quasicompact opens, constructible sets and clopen sets in cofiltered limits of spectral spaces come from a finite stage

*Lemma.* Let I be a small cofiltered category, i ↦ S_i a diagram of spectral spaces with spectral transition maps f_a: S_j → S_i (Mathlib `SpectralSpace`, `IsSpectralMap`), and S = lim_i S_i with projections p_i. Then: (a) every quasicompact open U ⊆ S equals p_i^{-1}(U_i) for some i and some quasicompact open U_i ⊆ S_i; more generally every constructible subset of S is the preimage of a constructible subset of some S_i; (b) if U_i, U_i' ⊆ S_i are quasicompact opens with p_i^{-1}(U_i) ⊆ p_i^{-1}(U_i') (resp. =), there is a: j → i with f_a^{-1}(U_i) ⊆ f_a^{-1}(U_i') (resp. =); in particular, if p_i^{-1}(U_i) = S then f_a^{-1}(U_i) = S_j for some a, and if p_i^{-1}(U_i) = ∅ then f_a^{-1}(U_i) = ∅ for some a; (c) finite unions and intersections of such identities hold at a common finite stage; (d) if U_i ⊆ S_i is a quasicompact open and p_i^{-1}(U_i) is open and closed in S, then f_a^{-1}(U_i) is open and closed in S_j for some a: j → i.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- I cofiltered; all S_i spectral and all transition maps spectral.

**Proof outline.**

1. S is spectral and the p_i are spectral (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces); the sets p_i^{-1}(V), V ⊆ S_i quasicompact open, form a basis of S closed under finite intersections (cofilteredness), so a quasicompact open is a finite union of them, all defined at a common stage: (a) for opens. Constructible sets: Stacks Tag 0A2Y.
2. (b): D := U_i ∖ U_i' is constructible, hence closed in the constructible topology and compact Hausdorff there (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/constructible-topology-profinite; tauceti:TauCeti.IsProConstructible.isCompact); the preimages D_j (j over I/i) form a cofiltered diagram of compact Hausdorff spaces, spectral maps being continuous for the constructible topologies, with limit p_i^{-1}(D) = ∅. A cofiltered limit of nonempty compact Hausdorff spaces is nonempty (mathlib:TopCat.nonempty_limitCone_of_compact_t2_cofiltered_system), so some D_j is empty.
3. (c) Finitely many applications of (b) at a common stage (cofilteredness).
4. (d) S ∖ p_i^{-1}(U_i) is closed in the spectral space S, hence quasicompact, and open, so by (a) it is p_j^{-1}(W_j); apply (b) to U_j ∪ W_j = S_j and U_j ∩ W_j = ∅ at a further stage (the argument of ECD's proof of 6.4(iii)).

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens: prerequisite of: Quasicompact opens and rational subsets of a cofiltered limit descend to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness: prerequisite of: Faithfulness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph argument)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection: prerequisite of: Surjectivity and isomorphism of qcqs étale maps are detected at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness: prerequisite of: Fullness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph approximation)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage: prerequisite of: Separatedness of a qcqs étale map is recognised at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit

**Acceptance.**

- S = lim_n {0,1}^n (Cantor set): its clopen subsets are exactly the preimages of subsets of some {0,1}^n; the open subset S ∖ {s} is not quasicompact and is not the preimage of an open subset of any finite stage, so quasicompactness is needed in (a).
- Sch12 Lemma 6.13(iv): a quasicompact open U_i containing the image of S contains the image of S_j for some j — the case p_i^{-1}(U_i) = S of (b).

**Prerequisites.** `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces`, `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/constructible-topology-profinite`, `mathlib:SpectralSpace`, `mathlib:IsSpectralMap`, `mathlib:WithConstructibleTopology`, `mathlib:TopCat.nonempty_limitCone_of_compact_t2_cofiltered_system`, `tauceti:TauCeti.IsProConstructible`, `tauceti:TauCeti.IsProConstructible.isCompact`.

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/Topology/Spectral/Limits

**namespace.** TauCeti

**Sources.**

- [`Stacks-Project`](#source-p0-stacks-project), Tag 0A30 (Lemma 5.24.6). Statement (a) for quasicompact opens; the lemma also contains (b) and (c).
- [`Stacks-Project`](#source-p0-stacks-project), Tag 0A2Y (Lemma 5.24.4). Statement (a) for constructible sets.
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (iii), p. 28. Statement (d).
- [`sch12-perfectoid`](#source-p0-sch12-perfectoid), Section 6, Lemma 6.13 (iv), p. 37. The special case p_i^{-1}(U_i) = S of (b).
- [`ScholzeWeinstein-Berkeley-2020`](#source-p0-scholzeweinstein-berkeley-2020), Lecture 8, proof of Lemma 8.2.4, printed p. 58. The compactness argument of step 2.

<a id="p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes` — Base changes of a qcqs perfectoid space along a cofiltered limit form a limit, with spectral underlying spaces

*Lemma.* In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let g_i: Y_i → X_i be a morphism of perfectoid spaces with Y_i quasicompact and quasiseparated (for instance a qcqs étale Y_i), and put Y_j := Y_i ×_{X_i} X_j (a: j → i) and Y := Y_i ×_{X_i} X, fibre products of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces). Then Y = lim_{j ∈ I/i} Y_j in perfectoid spaces, |Y| → lim_j |Y_j| is a homeomorphism of spectral spaces, and for every affinoid perfectoid open V_i ⊆ Y_i the V_j := V_i ×_{X_i} X_j are affinoid perfectoid with V := V_i ×_{X_i} X = lim V_j (so O(V) is the completed direct limit of the O(V_j)).

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; Y_i qcqs; fibre products of perfectoid spaces exist and fibre products of affinoid perfectoid spaces are affinoid perfectoid (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

**Proof outline.**

1. Limits commute with fibre products: for perfectoid T, Hom(T, Y_i ×_{X_i} X) = Hom(T, Y_i) ×_{Hom(T, X_i)} lim_j Hom(T, X_j) = lim_j Hom(T, Y_i ×_{X_i} X_j) (P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces, P2/perfectoid-fibre-product-universal-property).
2. Cover Y_i by finitely many affinoid perfectoid opens V_i^1, …, V_i^m; the V_j^k are affinoid perfectoid and V^k = lim_j V_j^k (step 1 with Y_i replaced by V_i^k), so |V^k| = lim |V_j^k| (P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism).
3. The |V^k| form an open cover of |Y|, and a point (y_j) of lim |Y_j| lies in lim_j |V_j^k| for any k with y_i ∈ V_i^k, since V_j^k is the preimage of V_i^k; so the homeomorphisms glue to |Y| ≅ lim |Y_j|. Y_j is qcqs, so |Y_j| is spectral (quasiseparated: Mathlib `QuasiSeparatedSpace`), and the limit is spectral (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces).

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens: prerequisite of: Quasicompact opens and rational subsets of a cofiltered limit descend to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness: prerequisite of: Faithfulness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph argument)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection: prerequisite of: Surjectivity and isomorphism of qcqs étale maps are detected at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness: prerequisite of: Fullness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph approximation)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage: prerequisite of: Separatedness of a qcqs étale map is recognised at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit

**Acceptance.**

- For Y_i = Y_i' ×_{X_i} Y_i'' with Y_i', Y_i'' qcqs étale (the Z_i of ECD's proof of 6.4(ii)), |Z| = lim |Z_j|.
- Profinite sets: for a finite étale Y_0 → Spa(K, O_K) = X_0, Y = S × Y_0 and |Y| = S × |Y_0|.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism`](#p5-limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/perfectoid-fibre-product-universal-property`](#p2-perfectoid-fibre-product-universal-property), `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cofiltered-limits-of-spectral-spaces`, `mathlib:QuasiSeparatedSpace`.

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Perfectoid/Limits

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), pp. 27-28. The identification |Z| = lim |Z_j| for the qcqs Z_i = Y_i ×_{X_i} Y_i', used without proof in ECD.

<a id="p5-descent-of-quasicompact-opens"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens` — Quasicompact opens and rational subsets of a cofiltered limit descend to a finite stage

*Lemma.* Let X = lim X_i be as in P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces, or more generally Y = lim_j Y_j for a qcqs Y_i → X_i and its base changes (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes). Then: (a) every quasicompact open U ⊆ |Y| is p_j^{-1}(U_j) for some j and some quasicompact open U_j ⊆ |Y_j|, and the open perfectoid subspace U is U_j ×_{Y_j} Y; (b) two quasicompact opens of |Y_j| with the same preimage in Y have the same preimage in some Y_k; if a quasicompact open contains the image of Y, it contains the image of Y_k for some k; (c) a quasicompact open of |Y_j| whose preimage in Y is open and closed has open and closed preimage in Y_k for some k; (d) every finite cover of Y by quasicompact opens is the pullback of a finite cover of some Y_j by quasicompact opens; (e) for Y = X: every rational subset of X is p_i^{-1}(U_i) for a rational subset U_i ⊆ X_i, i.e. for T ⊆ R finite generating R and s ∈ R there are i, T_i ⊆ R_i finite generating R_i and s_i ∈ R_i with R(T/s) = R(ι_i(T_i)/ι_i(s_i)).

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; for (a)-(d) any qcqs Y_i → X_i.

**Proof outline.**

1. |Y| = lim |Y_j| as spectral spaces (P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism for Y = X; P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes in general).
2. (a)-(d) are P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces applied to this limit; the open subspace structure: the base change of an open immersion is the open subspace on the preimage (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces, fibre products P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).
3. (e) is P5/spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs (c) for the perfectoid system.

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage

**Acceptance.**

- ECD, proof of 6.4(ii): the image of f_i: Y_i → Y_i' is a quasicompact open over which Y' → Y_i' factors, hence Y_j' → Y_i' factors over it for large j.
- Kedlaya–Liu Remark 2.6.7: any rational covering of the completed direct limit is defined at a finite stage.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism`](#p5-limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces`](#p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs`](#p5-spa-of-filtered-colimit-of-tate-pairs), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Perfectoid/Limits

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), p. 28. Descent of containment of quasicompact opens, used for surjectivity.
- [`KedlayaLiu-RelativeFoundations-2015`](#source-p0-kedlayaliu-relativefoundations-2015), Section 2.6, Remark 2.6.7, p. 54. Statement (d)/(e) for rational coverings.

<a id="p5-limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets` — Restriction of a cofiltered limit to a rational subset of a finite stage

*Lemma.* In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let U_i ⊆ X_i be a quasicompact open subset, U_j := X(a)^{-1}(U_i) for a: j → i, and U := p_i^{-1}(U_i) ⊆ X. Then U = lim_{j ∈ I/i} U_j in perfectoid spaces. If U_i is rational, then each U_j is a rational subset of X_j, hence affinoid perfectoid (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids), U is a rational subset of X, and (O_X(U), O_X⁺(U)) is the completed direct limit of the (O_{X_j}(U_j), O⁺_{X_j}(U_j)): the canonical map from the ϖ-adic completion of colim_j O⁺_{X_j}(U_j) to O⁺_X(U) is an isomorphism (Sch12 Lemma 6.13(iii), Kedlaya–Liu Lemma 2.6.5(a)).

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; U_i quasicompact open (rational for the ring statement).

**Proof outline.**

1. Base change of an open immersion is the open subspace on the preimage: U_j = U_i ×_{X_i} X_j and U = U_i ×_{X_i} X (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces).
2. For a perfectoid space Y, Hom(Y, U) is the set of f: Y → X with f(|Y|) ⊆ U; by P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces and P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism this is the set of compatible families f_j: Y → X_j with f_j(|Y|) ⊆ U_j, i.e. lim Hom(Y, U_j). So U = lim U_j.
3. Rational case: U_j and U are rational (preimages of rational subsets are rational, tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.Pair.Hom.spaComap_preimage_rationalSubset), affinoid perfectoid; P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces applied to (U_j) gives lim U_j = Spa of the completed direct limit, and uniqueness of limits identifies it with (O(U), O⁺(U)) (restriction maps: PerfectoidSpaces:P2/perfectoid-pair-rational-restriction).

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage

**Acceptance.**

- Profinite sets: for a clopen C_n ⊆ S_n, the restriction of S × Spa(K, O_K) to C × Spa(K, O_K) (C the preimage of C_n) is Spa(C^0(C, K), C^0(C, O_K)).
- For X₀ affinoid perfectoid and x ∈ U_0 rational, restricting the system of rational neighbourhoods of x to those inside U_0 does not change the limit Spa(K(x), K(x)⁺).

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism`](#p5-limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids`](#p2-rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/perfectoid-pair-rational-restriction`](#p2-perfectoid-pair-rational-restriction), `tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.Pair.Hom.spaComap_preimage_rationalSubset`.

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Perfectoid/Limits

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`sch12-perfectoid`](#source-p0-sch12-perfectoid), Section 6, Lemma 6.13 (iii), p. 37. The ring statement for rational subsets.
- [`KedlayaLiu-RelativeFoundations-2015`](#source-p0-kedlayaliu-relativefoundations-2015), Section 2.6, Lemma 2.6.5 (a), p. 54. Rational localisations of the completed direct limit come from a finite stage.
- [`KedlayaLiu-RelativeFoundations-2015`](#source-p0-kedlayaliu-relativefoundations-2015), Section 2.6, Lemma 2.6.5 (a), p. 54. The rational localisations form a system with completed direct limit the rational localisation of the limit.

<a id="p5-omega1-cofiltered-uncompleted-colimit"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/omega1-cofiltered-uncompleted-colimit` — ω₁-cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces need no completion

*Theorem.* In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces assume that I is ω₁-cofiltered: every functor J → I from a category J with countably many morphisms extends to a cone J^◁ → I (equivalently Mathlib `CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered Iᵒᵖ ℵ₁`, ℵ₁ regular by `Cardinal.isRegular_aleph_one`). Then A = colim_i R_i⁺ is ϖ-adically separated and complete, so the canonical maps colim_i R_i⁺ → R⁺ and colim_i R_i → R are ring isomorphisms (bijective). Equivalently, for an ℵ₁-filtered diagram of perfectoid Tate pairs the uncompleted colimit (colim R_i, colim R_i⁺), with colim R_i⁺ carrying its ϖ-adic topology, is a perfectoid Tate pair and O(lim X_i) = colim O(X_i). For countable index categories such as I = ℕᵒᵖ both properties fail in general: colim R_i⁺ → R⁺ need be neither surjective nor injective.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; I ω₁-cofiltered in ECD's sense (a countable diagram in I has a cone).

**Proof outline.**

1. Separated: if x ∈ ⋂_n ϖ^nA, choose for each n a stage i_n and y_n ∈ R_{i_n}⁺ witnessing x = ϖ^n y_n in the colimit, together with the morphisms relating these stages to a stage of x; these form a countable diagram in I, which has a cone j. In R_j⁺ the image x_j satisfies x_j ∈ ϖ^nR_j⁺ for all n, so x_j = 0 as R_j⁺ is ϖ-adically separated; hence x = 0 in A.
2. Complete: a Cauchy sequence (x_n) in A with x_{n+1} - x_n ∈ ϖ^nA involves countably many elements and relations, all realised in a single R_j⁺ by ω₁-cofilteredness; R_j⁺ is ϖ-adically complete, so the sequence has a limit in R_j⁺ whose image is a limit in A.
3. Hence A → Â = R⁺ is bijective (P5/completion-preserves-integral-closedness (a)); inverting ϖ, colim R_i = A[1/ϖ] → R⁺[1/ϖ] = R is bijective (P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs).

**Uses.**

- ECD Proposition 8.5 and Corollary 8.6: O and O⁺ commute with ω₁-filtered colimits, so they are small sheaves
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D2/cutoff-independence: a sheaf commuting with ω₁-filtered colimits of affinoid perfectoid pairs is small
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countably-generated-decomposition: prerequisite of: Every affinoid perfectoid space is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of topologically countably generated affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.5)

**Acceptance.**

- ECD Proposition 8.5 and Corollary 8.6: O and O⁺ commute with ω₁-filtered colimits of affinoid perfectoid pairs, which is this theorem applied to X ↦ O(X).
- Non-examples for I = ℕᵒᵖ: for the profinite system (S_n = {0,1}^n) colim R_n⁺ = LC(S, O_K) ≠ C^0(S, O_K) = R⁺ (not surjective); for R_n = K⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩ with T^{1/p^m} ↦ ϖ^{1/p^m}T^{1/p^m} the element T is in ⋂ ϖ^n colim R_n⁺, so colim R_n⁺ → R⁺ = O_K is not injective.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs`](#p5-completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-is-perfectoid`](#p5-completed-colimit-is-perfectoid), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completion-preserves-integral-closedness`](#p5-completion-preserves-integral-closedness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), `mathlib:CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered`, `mathlib:Cardinal.isRegular_aleph_one`, `mathlib:IsAdicComplete`.

<a id="p5-countable-perfectoid-hull"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countable-perfectoid-hull` — Every countable subset of a perfectoid Tate ring lies in a closed, topologically countably generated perfectoid subring

*Lemma.* Let (R, R⁺) be a perfectoid Tate pair and ϖ ∈ R⁺ a pseudouniformiser with ϖ^p | p in R⁺ and compatible p-power roots ϖ^{1/p^n} (P5/compatible-pseudouniformizer for the constant system). For every countable subset C ⊆ R there is a closed subring R' ⊆ R such that: C ∪ {ϖ, ϖ^{-1}} ∪ {ϖ^{1/p^n}} ⊆ R'; R' has a countable dense subset (equivalently R' is the closure of a countably generated subring: R' is topologically countably generated); R' with the subspace topology is a perfectoid Tate ring with R'° = R' ∩ R°; R'⁺ := R' ∩ R⁺ is a ring of integral elements of R', and the inclusion (R', R'⁺) → (R, R⁺) is a morphism of perfectoid Tate pairs. Moreover |R'| ≤ 2^{ℵ₀}.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- (R, R⁺) perfectoid Tate pair (ECD Definition 3.1); C countable.

**Proof outline.**

1. Choose countable subrings D_0 ⊆ D_1 ⊆ … of R: D_0 is generated by C, ϖ^{±1}, the ϖ^{1/p^n} and p/ϖ^p; D_{k+1} is generated by D_k and, for each d ∈ D_k ∩ R°, elements y_d, z_d ∈ R° with d = y_d^p + ϖ^p z_d, which exist because Frobenius R°/ϖ → R°/ϖ^p is surjective for every pseudouniformiser with ϖ^p | p (PerfectoidSpaces:P1/perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras, P1/perfectoid-condition-independent-of-pseudouniformizer). Put D := ⋃_k D_k (countable) and R' := closure of D.
2. R' is a closed subring of the complete R, hence complete; ϖ is a unit of R' (ϖ^{-1} ∈ D) and topologically nilpotent; R' ∩ R⁺ is open in R' and bounded, a ring of definition, so R' is a Tate ring (tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.IsTateRing). A subset of R' is bounded in R' iff it is bounded in R (for a subset of R', both conditions are equivalent to containment in ϖ^{-n}(R' ∩ R⁺) for some n), so R'° = R' ∩ R° is bounded: R' is uniform.
3. Frobenius: for x ∈ R'° choose d ∈ D with x - d ∈ ϖ^pR⁺ ∩ R' (density; an open neighbourhood of 0 in R'). Then d ∈ D ∩ R°, so y_d, z_d ∈ D ∩ R° ⊆ R'°, and x - y_d^p = (x - d) + ϖ^p z_d ∈ ϖ^p R'°. Also ϖ^p | p in R'° since p/ϖ^p ∈ D ∩ R°. Hence R' is perfectoid (ECD Definition 3.1).
4. R'⁺ = R' ∩ R⁺ is open in R', integrally closed in R' (R⁺ is integrally closed in R) and contained in R'° (tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.IsRingOfIntegralElements).
5. Cardinality: R' is complete metrisable with a countable dense subset, so every element is the limit of a sequence in D and |R'| ≤ ℵ₀^{ℵ₀} = 2^{ℵ₀} (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/completion-cardinality-bound, the case λ = ℵ₀).

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countably-generated-decomposition: prerequisite of: Every affinoid perfectoid space is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of topologically countably generated affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.5)

**Acceptance.**

- For R = C^0(S, K) with S = {0,1}^{ℵ₁} and K = C_p, and C a countable set of functions depending only on the coordinates in a countable J ⊆ ℵ₁, one may take R' = C^0({0,1}^J, C_p) pulled back to S.
- If R already has a countable dense subset (for example C_p⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩), one may take R' = R.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/compatible-pseudouniformizer`](#p5-compatible-pseudouniformizer), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P1/perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras`](#p1-perfectoid-tate-rings-and-algebras), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P1/perfectoid-condition-independent-of-pseudouniformizer`](#p1-perfectoid-condition-independent-of-pseudouniformizer), `tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.IsTateRing`, `tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.IsRingOfIntegralElements`, `tauceti:TauCeti.Huber.powerBoundedSubring`, `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/completion-cardinality-bound`, `mathlib:Cardinal.power_le_power_left`.

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/RingTheory/Perfectoid/CountablyGenerated

**namespace.** TauCeti.Perfectoid

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.5, p. 29. The family of perfectoid sub-pairs with a countable dense subset, whose supply this lemma guarantees (ECD gives no argument for it).
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 4, Remark 4.3, p. 20. The cardinality count of the last step.

<a id="p5-countably-generated-decomposition"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countably-generated-decomposition` — Every affinoid perfectoid space is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of topologically countably generated affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.5)

*Theorem.* Let X = Spa(R, R⁺) be an affinoid perfectoid space and ϖ as in P5/countable-perfectoid-hull. Let 𝒮(R) be the set of closed subrings R' ⊆ R containing ϖ^{±1} that are perfectoid Tate rings for the subspace topology and admit a countable dense subset, ordered by inclusion, and put R'⁺ := R' ∩ R⁺. Then: (a) 𝒮(R) is ω₁-directed (every countable subset of 𝒮(R) has an upper bound in 𝒮(R)) and ⋃_{R' ∈ 𝒮(R)} R' = R; (b) colim_{R' ∈ 𝒮(R)} (R', R'⁺) → (R, R⁺) is an isomorphism of Huber pairs, without completion; (c) X = lim_{R' ∈ 𝒮(R)} Spa(R', R'⁺) in perfectoid spaces and |X| = lim |Spa(R', R'⁺)|: X is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces with topologically countably generated rings of functions; (d) every R' ∈ 𝒮(R) has cardinality ≤ 2^{ℵ₀}; hence, for every uncountable strong limit cardinal κ (in particular every cutoff cardinal of ECD Lemma 4.1), X is an ω₁-cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces whose rings have cardinality < κ. This ω₁-presentation is the form in which ECD's cutoff-independence argument (Proposition 8.2) can be carried out for singular cutoff cardinals (see sourceIssues).

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- X affinoid perfectoid; no countability assumption on R.

**Proof outline.**

1. (a) Given countably many R'_k ∈ 𝒮(R) with countable dense subsets C_k, apply P5/countable-perfectoid-hull to ⋃_k C_k to get R'' ∈ 𝒮(R) containing every C_k, hence every R'_k (R'' is closed). Every x ∈ R lies in the hull of {x}.
2. (b) The union of an ω₁-directed family of subrings is the colimit, and it equals R and R⁺ by (a); no completion is needed (P5/omega1-cofiltered-uncompleted-colimit), and the topologies agree because R'⁺ carries the subspace, i.e. ϖ-adic, topology.
3. (c) P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces and P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism for the ω₁-cofiltered diagram 𝒮(R)^op, whose completed direct limit is (R, R⁺) by (b) (P5/limit-independence-of-tail-and-choice for the choice of ϖ).
4. (d) P5/countable-perfectoid-hull; 2^{ℵ₀} < κ for κ an uncountable strong limit (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cutoff-cardinal).

**Uses.**

- DiamondsAndVStacks:D2/cutoff-independence: presentations of κ′-small affinoids by κ-small ones, in the ω₁ form (sourceIssues PerfectoidSpaces/E34)
- Berkeley lectures, proof of Lemma 17.1.8: reduction of v-descent of vector bundles to topologically countably generated Banach algebras

**Acceptance.**

- X = Spa(C^0(S, C_p), C^0(S, O_{C_p})) with S = {0,1}^{ℵ₁}: the subrings C^0({0,1}^J, C_p), J ⊆ ℵ₁ countable, are cofinal in 𝒮(R), since a continuous function on S depends on countably many coordinates.
- Degenerate case: if R has a countable dense subset, R is the largest element of 𝒮(R) and the presentation is trivial.
- Non-example: if R has no countable dense subset, X is not the limit of an ℕᵒᵖ-indexed tower of topologically countably generated affinoid perfectoid spaces (the union of the countable dense subsets of the images would be a countable dense subset of R), so an uncountable ω₁-cofiltered index category is necessary.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/countable-perfectoid-hull`](#p5-countable-perfectoid-hull), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/omega1-cofiltered-uncompleted-colimit`](#p5-omega1-cofiltered-uncompleted-colimit), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism`](#p5-limit-underlying-space-homeomorphism), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-independence-of-tail-and-choice`](#p5-limit-independence-of-tail-and-choice), `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cutoff-cardinal`, `mathlib:CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered`, `mathlib:Cardinal.isRegular_aleph_one`.

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, Proposition 6.5, statement, p. 29. The statement of the decomposition.
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.5, p. 29. The index family 𝒮(R).
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 8, proof of Proposition 8.2, p. 39. The presentation ECD's cutoff argument needs; for singular κ it has to be replaced by the ω₁-presentation (d) (sourceIssues).

**Planet.** ω₁-cofiltered limits.

<a id="p5-limit-cardinal-bounds"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-cardinal-bounds` — Cardinal bounds for cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces

*Theorem.* Let κ be a cutoff cardinal (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cutoff-cardinal, ECD Lemma 4.1), λ < κ a cardinal, I a cofiltered category with fewer than λ morphisms, and X_i = Spa(R_i, R_i⁺) (i ∈ I) a cofiltered diagram of affinoid perfectoid spaces such that |R_i| < κ' for all i, for some strong limit cardinal κ' < κ (this holds when all X_i are κ'-small in the sense of ECD Definition 4.2). Let X = Spa(R, R⁺) = lim X_i. Then |colim R_i⁺| < κ, |R⁺| < κ, |R| < κ, |X| < κ, and |O_X(U)| < κ for every open affinoid U ⊆ X. These are the two conditions of ECD Definition 4.2, so X is κ-small; PerfectoidSpaces:P6/kappa-small-perfectoid-space defines κ-smallness by exactly these conditions.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- κ as in ECD Lemma 4.1; I λ-small with λ < κ; each |R_i| < κ' with κ' < κ a strong limit cardinal.

**Proof outline.**

1. By clause (iii) of DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cutoff-cardinal (the κ_μ being cofinal in κ) choose a strong limit cardinal κ'' with κ' ≤ κ'' < κ and cofinality of κ'' larger than λ.
2. |colim R_i⁺| ≤ Σ_{i} |R_i| is a sum of fewer than λ < cf(κ'') cardinals each < κ'', hence < κ''.
3. R⁺ is first countable (ϖ-adic) with a dense subring (the image of colim R_i⁺) of cardinality μ < κ'' < κ, so |R⁺| ≤ μ^{ℵ₀} ≤ 2^μ < κ (DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/completion-cardinality-bound; κ strong limit); |R| ≤ |R⁺|·ℵ₀ since R = ⋃_n ϖ^{-n}R⁺.
4. |X| ≤ |Set(R × R)| = 2^{|R|} < κ: a point of Spa(R, R⁺) is a valuative relation on R, i.e. a subset of R × R (tauceti:TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum; mathlib:Cardinal.mk_set).
5. For U ⊆ X open affinoid, U is a finite union of rational subsets U_k of X (quasicompactness), O(U) ↪ ∏_k O(U_k) (sheaf property, PerfectoidSpaces:P2/perfectoid-stably-uniform-and-sheafy), and O(U_k) has a dense subring of the form R[1/s_k] of cardinality |R| (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids), so |O(U_k)| < κ by DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/completion-cardinality-bound.

**Uses.**

- DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/universally-open-std-cover: X_∞ = lim_J X_J is κ-small
- PerfectoidSpaces:P6/kappa-small-perfectoid-space: the numerical bounds are the two conditions of ECD Definition 4.2

**Acceptance.**

- I = ℕᵒᵖ, K = C_p, S = {0,1}^ℕ: |C^0(S, C_p)| = 2^{ℵ₀} < κ for every cutoff cardinal κ.
- ECD's proof of Lemma 7.18 (DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/universally-open-std-cover): X_∞ = lim_J X_J with fewer than κ finite subsets J and κ-small X_J is κ-small.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs`](#p5-completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs), `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/cutoff-cardinal`, `DiamondsAndVStacks:D0/completion-cardinality-bound`, [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids`](#p2-rational-localization-of-perfectoid-affinoids), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/perfectoid-stably-uniform-and-sheafy`](#p2-perfectoid-stably-uniform-and-sheafy), `tauceti:TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum`, `mathlib:Cardinal.IsStrongLimit`, `mathlib:Cardinal.mk_set`, `mathlib:Cardinal.power_le_power_left`.

<a id="p5-filtered-two-colimit-of-categories"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories` — The 2-colimit of a filtered diagram of categories

*Construction.* Let J be a small filtered category and F a pseudofunctor from J (as a locally discrete bicategory) to categories (Mathlib `CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor`): categories C_j, functors F_a: C_i → C_j for a: i → j, and coherent natural isomorphisms F_{ba} ≅ F_b ∘ F_a and F_{id} ≅ id. The filtered 2-colimit 2-colim_j C_j is the category whose objects are pairs (i, x) with x an object of C_i, whose morphisms are Hom((i, x), (j, y)) := colim_{(k, a: i → k, b: j → k)} Hom_{C_k}(F_a x, F_b y) (a filtered colimit of sets over the category of cospans under i and j), with composition and identities induced from the C_k (Berkeley Remark 7.4.7). It carries functors ι_i: C_i → 2-colim C_j and isomorphisms ι_j ∘ F_a ≅ ι_i, and is the pseudo-colimit of F: pseudo-cocones (G_i: C_i → D, G_j ∘ F_a ≅ G_i coherently) correspond, up to unique isomorphism, to functors G: 2-colim C_j → D. For a pseudo-cocone the induced G is faithful iff morphisms in some C_k with equal images in D become equal in some further C_{k'}; full iff every morphism G_i x → G_j y of D comes from a morphism in some C_k; essentially surjective iff every object of D is isomorphic to some G_i x. In this layer J = Iᵒᵖ, C_i = a category of objects over X_i and F_a = base change; 'the base change functors induce an equivalence 2-colim (X_i)_? → X_?' means that the induced G is an equivalence.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- J small and filtered; F a pseudofunctor (base change is only defined up to canonical isomorphism).

**Proof outline.**

1. Composition: representatives f ∈ Hom_{C_k}(F_a x, F_b y), g ∈ Hom_{C_l}(F_c y, F_d z) are pushed to a common k' under k, l compatible on j (filteredness) and composed there, using the coherence isomorphisms of F; independence of representatives and associativity are checked at a further common stage.
2. The ι_i and ι_j ∘ F_a ≅ ι_i are the identity on representatives; a pseudo-cocone defines G(i, x) := G_i x and G on representatives via the cocone isomorphisms; uniqueness up to unique isomorphism is formal.
3. The three criteria unwind the definition of Hom in 2-colim C_j and Mathlib's `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsEquivalence` (fully faithful and essentially surjective).

**API.**

- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit` (data): For a filtered J and a pseudofunctor F from J to Cat: the category 2-colim F with objects Σ j, F.obj j.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.ι` (constructor): The canonical functor ι_j: F.obj j ⥤ FilteredTwoColimit F.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.ιCompIso` (structure): For a: i → j, the isomorphism F_a ⋙ ι_j ≅ ι_i, compatible with the coherence isomorphisms of F.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.homEquiv` (characterisation): Hom((i, x), (j, y)) ≃ colimit over cospans (k, a, b) of Hom_{F k}(F_a x, F_b y).
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.desc` (universal-property): The functor FilteredTwoColimit F ⥤ D induced by a pseudo-cocone (G_i, G_j ∘ F_a ≅ G_i).
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.ιCompDescIso` (simp): ι_i ⋙ desc G ≅ G_i.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.descUniqueIso` (extensionality): Any functor H with isomorphisms ι_i ⋙ H ≅ G_i compatible with the cocone is uniquely isomorphic to desc G.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.isEquivalence_desc_iff` (characterisation): desc G is an equivalence iff (a) for all (i, x), (j, y) the map colim_k Hom(F_a x, F_b y) → Hom_D(G_i x, G_j y) is bijective and (b) every object of D is isomorphic to some G_i x.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.equivOfFinal` (functoriality): For a final functor u: J' ⥤ J, the induced functor FilteredTwoColimit (F ∘ u) ⥤ FilteredTwoColimit F is an equivalence (restriction to a tail).
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.fullSubcategory` (compatibility): If C'_j ⊆ C_j are full subcategories stable under the F_a, then 2-colim C'_j is equivalent to the full subcategory of 2-colim C_j on the (i, x) with x ∈ C'_i.
- `CategoryTheory.FilteredTwoColimit.equivConst` (example): For the constant pseudofunctor at a category C (identity transition functors), FilteredTwoColimit ≌ C.

**Unit tests.**

- `filteredTwoColimit_test_const` (degenerate): For J the one-object category and F = C, FilteredTwoColimit F ≌ C.
- `filteredTwoColimit_test_discrete` (computation): For J = ℕ and C_n the discrete category on a set E_n with maps E_n → E_{n+1}, FilteredTwoColimit F is equivalent to the discrete category on colim_n E_n.
- `filteredTwoColimit_test_finitelyPresentedModules` (compatibility): For a filtered diagram of rings B_j with colimit B, base change 2-colim_j Mod^{fp}(B_j) → Mod^{fp}(B) (finitely presented modules) is an equivalence (EGA IV 8.5.2).
- `filteredTwoColimit_test_notNaive` (non-example): Let C_0 have two objects with no morphisms between them and C_n (n ≥ 1) have two isomorphic objects, with the evident functors: in 2-colim the two objects of C_0 become isomorphic, so the naive category with object set colim Ob(C_n) and morphisms taken in C_0 is not equivalent to the 2-colimit.

**Uses.**

- Berkeley Remark 7.4.7 and Theorem 7.4.8: the category 2-lim of finite étale algebras over a directed system of Tate rings
- Sch12 Lemma 7.5 and ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)-(iv): finite étale, qcqs étale, qc separated étale and affinoid étale objects over a limit form the 2-colimit
- ECD proofs of Proposition 7.10 and Proposition 11.23: Y_ét,qcqs = 2-lim (Y_i)_ét,qcqs; F(Y) = 2-lim F(Y_µ) for the étale prestacks of diamonds
- Kedlaya–Liu Remark 1.2.9 and Proposition 2.6.8; Kedlaya AWS Definition 4.1.1(a): the direct 2-limit of FÉt over a direct system of rings
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D5/limits-and-finite-stage-comparisons: 2-colimits of finite étale, qcqs étale and qc separated étale objects over diamonds
- AdicEtaleGeometry:A3/affinoid-etale-finite-stage-6-4-iv and A3/independence-of-presentations: 2-colim (X_i)_ét,aff → X_ét,aff and the well-definedness of finite-stage models
- P5/finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation, P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent, P5/quasicompact-separated-etale-finite-stage-descent: statements of ECD 6.4 (i)-(iii)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-filtered-colimit-of-rings and P3/finite-etale-completed-direct-limit: the 2-colimit of finite étale algebras over a filtered colimit of rings and over a completed direct limit of Tate rings (stated there in the explicit form of the criterion isEquivalence_desc_iff)

**Acceptance.**

- Berkeley Remark 7.4.7: for the filtered system of categories of finite étale algebras over complete Tate rings A_i, Hom in the 2-colimit is the colimit of Hom over common targets, and the comparison functor to finite étale algebras over the completed colimit is an equivalence (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-completed-direct-limit read through isEquivalence_desc_iff).
- For the constant pseudofunctor at a category C over a filtered J the 2-colimit is equivalent to C.

<a id="p5-finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation` — Finite étale objects over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces come from a finite stage (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i))

*Theorem.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). Let X = Spa(R, R⁺) = lim_i X_i be a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces X_i = Spa(R_i, R_i⁺) (P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces). Then the base change functors (X_i)_fét → X_fét induce an equivalence of categories 2-colim_i (X_i)_fét → X_fét (P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories). Ring form: base change S_i ↦ S_i ⊗_{R_i} R (no completion; the tensor product is finite projective over R) induces an equivalence 2-colim_i FÉt(R_i) → FÉt(R), compatible with tensor products and ranks, and the plus rings of the corresponding perfectoid spaces are the integral closures of R_i⁺, R⁺. Explicitly: (lifting) every finite étale R-algebra is S_i ⊗_{R_i} R for some i and some finite étale R_i-algebra S_i; (uniqueness) for finite étale R_i-algebras S_i, S_i', every R-algebra map S_i ⊗ R → S_i' ⊗ R is the base change of an R_j-algebra map for some j → i, and two R_j-algebra maps with the same base change to R agree over some R_k. The theorem concerns finite étale algebras; finitely presented algebras over R do not in general come from a finite stage.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; (i₀, ϖ) a compatible pseudouniformiser.
- The algebraic input — finite étale algebras over a completed direct limit of complete Tate rings, through the henselian approximation theorem (Elkik; Gabber–Ramero arXiv Proposition 5.4.54 = book 5.4.53; Berkeley Theorem 7.4.8) — is owned by PerfectoidSpaces:P3 (P3/finite-etale-completed-direct-limit, P3/henselian-finite-etale-approximation) and imported; this node adds the identification of the completion with the limit's ring and the passage to spaces.

**Proof outline.**

1. Ring form: apply PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-completed-direct-limit to the filtered system (R_i) with the compatible rings of definition A_{i,0} = R_i⁺ (bounded, as R_i is uniform) and the compatible pseudouniformiser ϖ. Its proof is: 2-colim FÉt(R_i) ≅ FÉt(L) for L := colim R_i (P3/finite-etale-filtered-colimit-of-rings), L is topologically henselian with ring of definition L_0 = colim R_i⁺ (P3/henselian-pairs-colimits-and-completions (b), (c)), and FÉt(L) ≅ FÉt(L̂) (P3/henselian-finite-etale-approximation (b); Gabber–Ramero 5.4.54 with t = ϖ, I = L_0; Berkeley Theorem 7.4.8).
2. The completion L̂ of L for the ϖ-adic topology on L_0 is the ring R of P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs (L̂_0 = R⁺ and L̂ = R⁺[1/ϖ]), and the composite 2-colim FÉt(R_i) → FÉt(R) is S_i ↦ S_i ⊗_{R_i} R because (S_i ⊗_{R_i} L) ⊗_L R = S_i ⊗_{R_i} R.
3. Geometric form: for an affinoid perfectoid Z = Spa(T, T⁺), W ↦ O(W) is an anti-equivalence Z_fét ≅ FÉt(T)^op with inverse S ↦ Spa(S, integral closure of T⁺ in S) (ECD after Definition 6.2; PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale (c), P3/finite-etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces, P3/strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids, P3/finite-etale-over-perfectoid-is-perfectoid), and base change of spaces corresponds to S_i ↦ S_i ⊗_{R_i} R (P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

**Uses.**

- ECD proof of Lemma 7.16: a split finite étale cover over a component spreads out
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D3/etale-and-finite-etale-are-v-stacks: finite étale objects over affinoid pro-étale limits come from a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-descent-of-qcqs-etale-objects: prerequisite of: Finite-stage descent along cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)–(iii))

**Acceptance.**

- Profinite sets: finite étale C^0(S, K)-algebras are, locally on S, constant: each is (S_n-indexed family of finite étale K-algebras) ⊗ C^0(S, K) for some n.
- A finite étale cover of a limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces is the pullback of one at a finite stage, unique up to unique isomorphism after enlarging the stage (ECD proof of Lemma 7.16: a splitting over a connected component extends to a neighbourhood).
- Non-example: C^0(S, K)/(f) with f(s) = Σ_k s_k ϖ^k is finitely presented but not flat, so not a base change from any finite stage; the theorem is special to finite étale algebras.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-completed-direct-limit`](#p3-finite-etale-completed-direct-limit), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-filtered-colimit-of-rings`](#p3-finite-etale-filtered-colimit-of-rings), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/henselian-pairs-colimits-and-completions`](#p3-henselian-pairs-colimits-and-completions), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs`](#p5-completed-colimit-of-perfectoid-pairs), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/completed-colimit-is-perfectoid`](#p5-completed-colimit-is-perfectoid), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories`](#p5-filtered-two-colimit-of-categories), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/henselian-finite-etale-approximation`](#p3-henselian-finite-etale-approximation), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale`](#p3-perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p3-finite-etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids`](#p3-strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/finite-etale-over-perfectoid-is-perfectoid`](#p3-finite-etale-over-perfectoid-is-perfectoid), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), `mathlib:CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale`.

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

<a id="p5-finite-stage-faithfulness"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness` — Faithfulness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph argument)

*Lemma.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let Y_i, Y_i' ∈ (X_i)_ét,qcqs and f_i, g_i: Y_i → Y_i' morphisms over X_i. If their base changes f, g: Y → Y' over X are equal, then f_j = g_j for some a: j → i (f_j, g_j the base changes to X_j). Equivalently, the functor 2-colim_i (X_i)_ét,qcqs → X_ét,qcqs is faithful.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; Y_i, Y_i' qcqs étale over X_i.

**Proof outline.**

1. The graph Γ_{f_i}: Y_i → Z_i := Y_i ×_{X_i} Y_i' is a section of the projection Z_i → Y_i, which is étale (base change of Y_i' → X_i, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open); sections of étale maps are open immersions (a section is the base change of the diagonal, an open immersion for étale maps: PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (5); AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-diagonal (b) via P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale). Γ_{f_i} is an injection (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-of-perfectoid-spaces), so it is determined by the quasicompact open image Γ_{f_i}(|Y_i|) ⊆ |Z_i| (ECD Proposition 5.3(iv), PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-criteria). Likewise for g_i.
2. Z_i is qcqs, and Z = Z_i ×_{X_i} X = lim_j Z_j with |Z| = lim |Z_j| spectral (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes).
3. The two images agree after pullback to |Z| (f = g); by P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces (b) they agree after pullback to |Z_j| for some j. The base changes Γ_{f_j}, Γ_{g_j} are the graphs of f_j, g_j and have these pulled-back images, so f_j = g_j.

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness: prerequisite of: Fullness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph approximation)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent: prerequisite of: Quasicompact quasiseparated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (ii))

**Acceptance.**

- Two X_0-endomorphisms of a finite étale Y_0 → X_0 that agree over the limit agree at a finite stage.
- Faithfulness fails for non-quasicompact Y_i: the argument needs the images of the graphs to be quasicompact.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces`](#p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p3-etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open`](#p3-etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale`](#p3-perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale), `AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-diagonal`, [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p4-injection-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-criteria`](#p4-injection-criteria), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

**Proposed library location (part record).** **module.** TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Perfectoid/FiniteStageDescent

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

**Sources.**

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), p. 27. Step 1.
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), p. 28. Step 3.
- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 5, Proposition 5.3, p. 21. Injections are determined by their image.

<a id="p5-finite-stage-isomorphism-detection"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection` — Surjectivity and isomorphism of qcqs étale maps are detected at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit

*Lemma.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let h_i: Y_i → Y_i' be a morphism in (X_i)_ét,qcqs with base changes h_j over X_j and h over X. (a) If |h| is surjective, then |h_j| is surjective for some a: j → i; in particular, if a qcqs étale Y_i → X_i has surjective base change to X, then Y_j → X_j is surjective for some j. (b) If h is an isomorphism, then h_j is an isomorphism for some j.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; h_i a morphism of qcqs étale X_i-spaces (automatically étale by cancellation, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (3)).

**Proof outline.**

1. (a) h_i is étale with quasicompact source, so W_i := h_i(|Y_i|) is a quasicompact open subset of |Y_i'| (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (5)). The image of h_j is the preimage of W_i in |Y_j'|, because |Y_i ×_{Y_i'} Y_j'| → |Y_i| ×_{|Y_i'|} |Y_j'| is surjective (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/fibre-product-points-surjective; Y_j = Y_i ×_{Y_i'} Y_j'); likewise over X. If h is surjective, the preimage of W_i in |Y'| is |Y'| = lim |Y_j'| (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), so by P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces (b) the preimage of W_i in |Y_j'| is all of |Y_j'| for some j.
2. (b) Apply (a) to h_i and to the diagonal Δ_{h_i}: Y_i → Y_i ×_{Y_i'} Y_i, a morphism of qcqs étale X_i-spaces and an open immersion (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (5)), whose base change Δ_h is an isomorphism. For large j, Δ_{h_j} is a surjective open immersion, hence an isomorphism, so h_j is an injection (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-of-perfectoid-spaces), and h_j is surjective by (a).
3. A surjective étale injection is an isomorphism: |h_j| is a continuous open bijection, hence a homeomorphism; by ECD Proposition 5.3(iv) (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-criteria) h_j is final among maps whose underlying map factors continuously through |Y_j|, so id_{Y_j'} factors through h_j, and h_j is an isomorphism.

**Uses.**

- AdicEtaleGeometry:A3/independence-of-presentations: finite-stage models of affinoid étale objects are unique
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D2/pro-etale-etale-comparison-and-structure-sheaves: étale surjections descend to a finite level
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness: prerequisite of: Fullness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph approximation)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-descent-of-qcqs-etale-objects: prerequisite of: Finite-stage descent along cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)–(iii))

**Acceptance.**

- ECD's proof of 6.4(ii) (the intermediate step to fullness) and AdicEtaleGeometry:A3/independence-of-presentations use (b).
- DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/universally-open-std-cover and D2/pro-etale-etale-comparison-and-structure-sheaves use (a): an étale surjection over the limit is an étale surjection at a finite stage.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces`](#p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open`](#p3-etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/fibre-product-points-surjective`](#p4-fibre-product-points-surjective), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p4-injection-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/injection-criteria`](#p4-injection-criteria), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps`](#p4-quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), p. 28. Statement (a).

<a id="p5-finite-stage-fullness"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness` — Fullness of base change to a cofiltered limit on qcqs étale objects (graph approximation)

*Lemma.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let Y_i, Y_i' ∈ (X_i)_ét,qcqs and let f: Y → Y' be a morphism over X between their base changes. Then there are a: j → i and a morphism f_j: Y_j → Y_j' over X_j whose base change to X is f. Together with P5/finite-stage-faithfulness: 2-colim_i (X_i)_ét,qcqs → X_ét,qcqs is fully faithful.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting.

**Proof outline.**

1. The graph Γ_f: Y → Y ×_X Y' is a section of the étale projection, hence an open immersion (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (5); AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-diagonal (b)), with quasicompact image since Y is quasicompact.
2. |Y ×_X Y'| = lim_j |Z_j|, Z_j = Y_j ×_{X_j} Y_j' (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes); by P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces (a) the image of Γ_f is the preimage of a quasicompact open V_j ⊆ |Z_j|, and V_j is an open perfectoid subspace of Z_j (P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces), qcqs étale over X_j.
3. The projection V_j → Y_j is a morphism in (X_j)_ét,qcqs whose base change to X is the isomorphism Γ_f(Y) → Y; by P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection (b), V_k → Y_k is an isomorphism for some k → j. Put f_k := pr_2 ∘ (V_k → Y_k)^{-1}: Y_k → Y_k'; its base change is pr_2 ∘ Γ_f = f.

**Uses.**

- ECD proof of Proposition 7.10: Hom_X(Y, Z) = colim Hom_X(Y_i, Z) for affinoid pro-étale Y and étale Z (PerfectoidSpaces:P6/pro-etale-pro-category-equivalence)
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity: prerequisite of: Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent: prerequisite of: Quasicompact quasiseparated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (ii))

**Acceptance.**

- ECD's proof of Proposition 7.10: Hom_X(Y, Z) = colim_i Hom_X(Y_i, Z) for an affinoid pro-étale Y = lim Y_i and an étale Z, which is this fullness applied to Y_i ×_X Z → Y_i.
- A section over the limit of an étale cover descends to a section over a finite stage.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness`](#p5-finite-stage-faithfulness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection`](#p5-finite-stage-isomorphism-detection), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces`](#p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces), `AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-diagonal`, [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale`](#p3-perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open`](#p3-etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces).

<a id="p5-qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity` — Every qcqs étale space over a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces descends to a finite stage

*Lemma.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces, every Y ∈ X_ét,qcqs is isomorphic over X to Y_i ×_{X_i} X for some i and some Y_i ∈ (X_i)_ét,qcqs.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; Y quasicompact and quasiseparated, étale over X.

**Proof outline.**

1. Local structure: every point of Y has an open neighbourhood V with V ⊆ W → U ⊆ X, where U is a rational subset of X, W → U is finite étale (so W is affinoid perfectoid) and V is a rational subset of W (ECD Definition 6.2(ii); standard affinoid form AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-morphism via PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale; PerfectoidSpaces:P3/strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids). As Y is quasicompact, finitely many such V^1, …, V^m cover Y.
2. Each piece descends: U = p_i^{-1}(U_i) for a rational U_i ⊆ X_i (P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens (e)); U = lim_j U_j (P5/limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets); W → U descends to a finite étale W_j → U_j (P5/finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation applied to the system (U_j)); W = lim W_j (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), so the rational V ⊆ W descends to a rational V_j ⊆ W_j (P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens (e)). Thus V^k ≅ V^k_j ×_{X_j} X with V^k_j qcqs étale over X_j.
3. Gluing: Y is quasiseparated, so V^k ∩ V^l is a quasicompact open of V^k = lim_j V^k_j and descends to a quasicompact open V^{kl}_j ⊆ V^k_j (P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens (a)); the identifications V^{kl} ≅ V^{lk} descend to isomorphisms over some X_j (P5/finite-stage-fullness and P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection (b)), and the finitely many cocycle conditions hold at a further stage (P5/finite-stage-faithfulness). Glue (anchor Layer 5 gluing, P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces) to Y_j, qcqs and étale over X_j, with Y_j ×_{X_j} X ≅ Y.

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent: prerequisite of: Quasicompact quasiseparated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (ii))

**Acceptance.**

- A rational subset of a finite étale cover of a rational subset of X descends; a finite union of such opens glued along quasicompact overlaps descends.
- Non-example: for X = S × Spa(K, O_K) (S profinite without isolated points), the open subspace Y = X ∖ ({s₀} × Spa(K, O_K)) is étale and quasiseparated but not quasicompact, and it is not the base change of an open subspace of any finite stage.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation`](#p5-finite-etale-finite-stage-approximation), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/descent-of-quasicompact-opens`](#p5-descent-of-quasicompact-opens), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets`](#p5-limit-restriction-to-rational-subsets), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness`](#p5-finite-stage-faithfulness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness`](#p5-finite-stage-fullness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-isomorphism-detection`](#p5-finite-stage-isomorphism-detection), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p3-etale-morphism-of-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale`](#p3-perfectoid-vs-analytic-finite-etale), `AdicEtaleGeometry:A1/etale-morphism`, [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids`](#p3-strongly-finite-etale-maps-are-affinoid-over-affinoids), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-open-subspaces-of-perfectoid-spaces).

**Imports from Tau Ceti roadmaps.** `tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AdicSpaces#layer-5-adic-spaces-and-elementary-geometry`.

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 6, proof of Proposition 6.4 (ii), p. 28. Steps 1-2.

<a id="p5-qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent` — Quasicompact quasiseparated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (ii))

*Theorem.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). Let X = lim_i X_i be a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces (P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces). Then the base change functors (X_i)_ét,qcqs → X_ét,qcqs induce an equivalence of categories 2-colim_i (X_i)_ét,qcqs → X_ét,qcqs (the 2-colimit of P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories for the base-change pseudofunctor on Iᵒᵖ). Explicitly: for Y_i, Y_i' ∈ (X_i)_ét,qcqs, colim_{j → i} Hom_{X_j}(Y_j, Y_j') → Hom_X(Y, Y') is bijective, and every qcqs étale Y → X is isomorphic to the base change of some qcqs étale Y_i → X_i.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting.

**Proof outline.**

1. Base change preserves qcqs étale objects (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open; P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), so it defines a pseudo-cocone and a comparison functor from the 2-colimit.
2. Faithful: P5/finite-stage-faithfulness; full: P5/finite-stage-fullness; essentially surjective: P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity; conclude by the criterion `isEquivalence_desc_iff` of P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories.

**Uses.**

- ECD proof of Proposition 7.10: Y_ét,qcqs = 2-lim (Y_i)_ét,qcqs
- AdicEtaleGeometry:A3/affinoid-etale-finite-stage-6-4-iv: full faithfulness of the affinoid étale comparison
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-separated-etale-finite-stage-descent: prerequisite of: Quasicompact separated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (iii))
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-descent-of-qcqs-etale-objects: prerequisite of: Finite-stage descent along cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)–(iii))

**Acceptance.**

- ECD proof of Proposition 7.10: for Y = lim Y_i affinoid pro-étale over X, Y_ét,qcqs = 2-colim (Y_i)_ét,qcqs.
- ECD proof of Lemma 7.16 (DiamondsAndVStacks:D1/strictly-totally-disconnected): a qcqs étale cover of X that splits over a connected component Spa(C, C⁺) = lim of its clopen neighbourhoods splits over a neighbourhood.
- Quasicompactness is necessary: the non-quasicompact open X ∖ ({s₀} × Spa(K, O_K)) of S × Spa(K, O_K) does not descend.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-faithfulness`](#p5-finite-stage-faithfulness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-fullness`](#p5-finite-stage-fullness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity`](#p5-qcqs-etale-essential-surjectivity), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories`](#p5-filtered-two-colimit-of-categories), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces`](#p5-cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space`](#p3-etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open`](#p3-etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces`](#p2-fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces).

<a id="p5-separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage"></a>

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage` — Separatedness of a qcqs étale map is recognised at a finite stage of a cofiltered limit

*Lemma.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). In the situation of P5/cofiltered-limits-of-affinoid-perfectoid-spaces let f_i: Y_i → X_i be qcqs étale. If the base change f: Y → X is separated (ECD Definition 5.10: Δ_f is a closed immersion; PerfectoidSpaces:P4/separated-perfectoid-map), then f_j: Y_j → X_j is separated for some a: j → i.

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting; f_i qcqs étale.

**Proof outline.**

1. For an étale map g: Z → T of perfectoid spaces, Δ_g: Z → Z ×_T Z is an open immersion (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open (5); ECD Proposition 5.9, PerfectoidSpaces:P4/diagonal-of-perfectoid-map), with quasicompact image when Z is quasicompact; g is separated iff |Δ_g| is a closed immersion (ECD Proposition 5.11 (i)⇔(ii), PerfectoidSpaces:P4/valuative-criterion-separatedness), i.e. iff the quasicompact open Δ_g(|Z|) is also closed.
2. S_j := |Y_j ×_{X_j} Y_j| is spectral and lim_j S_j = |Y ×_X Y| (P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes applied to the qcqs Y_i ×_{X_i} Y_i); the preimage of U_i := Δ_{f_i}(|Y_i|) is Δ_f(|Y|), which is open and closed. By P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces (d), the preimage U_j of U_i in S_j is open and closed for some j; U_j = Δ_{f_j}(|Y_j|) since diagonals commute with base change. So f_j is separated.

**Uses.**

- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-separated-etale-finite-stage-descent: prerequisite of: Quasicompact separated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (iii))
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-descent-of-qcqs-etale-objects: prerequisite of: Finite-stage descent along cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)–(iii))

**Acceptance.**

- Let X_n := {|T| ≤ |ϖ|^n} ⊆ X_0 = Spa(K⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩, O_K⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩), with limit Spa(K, K⁺) (the origin); Y_1 := two copies of X_1 glued along V_1 = {|T| ≤ |ϖ|^2} is qcqs étale over X_1 and not separated, while its base change to X_2 (two copies of X_2 glued along X_2) is X_2, which is separated: the stage must be enlarged.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/limit-of-qcqs-base-changes`](#p5-limit-of-qcqs-base-changes), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces`](#p5-quasicompact-opens-in-limits-of-spectral-spaces), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open`](#p3-etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/separated-perfectoid-map`](#p4-separated-perfectoid-map), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/valuative-criterion-separatedness`](#p4-valuative-criterion-separatedness), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/diagonal-of-perfectoid-map`](#p4-diagonal-of-perfectoid-map).

**namespace.** TauCeti.PerfectoidSpace

- [`Scholze-EtaleCohomologyDiamonds`](#source-p0-scholze-etalecohomologydiamonds), Section 5, Proposition 5.11 (ii), p. 25. The topological criterion for separatedness.

### `PerfectoidSpaces:P5/quasicompact-separated-etale-finite-stage-descent` — Quasicompact separated étale objects over a cofiltered limit form the 2-colimit (ECD Proposition 6.4 (iii))

*Theorem.* For a perfectoid space Z, Z_ét is the category of perfectoid spaces étale over Z (ECD Definition 6.2, PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-site-of-perfectoid-space), Z_fét, Z_ét,qcqs and Z_ét,qc,sep its full subcategories of finite étale, of quasicompact quasiseparated (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/quasicompact-and-quasiseparated-maps), and of quasicompact separated étale spaces, and base change along X_j → X_i or X → X_i is the fibre product of perfectoid spaces (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/fibre-products-of-perfectoid-spaces), which preserves these classes (PerfectoidSpaces:P3/etale-morphisms-composition-base-change-open). Let X = lim_i X_i be a cofiltered limit of affinoid perfectoid spaces. Then the base change functors (X_i)_ét,qc,sep → X_ét,qc,sep induce an equivalence of categories 2-colim_i (X_i)_ét,qc,sep → X_ét,qc,sep, where X_ét,qc,sep ⊆ X_ét,qcqs is the full subcategory of quasicompact separated étale perfectoid spaces over X (a separated étale space over an affinoid is quasiseparated).

**Hypotheses and scope.**

- The standing setting.

**Proof outline.**

1. Base change preserves separatedness (PerfectoidSpaces:P4/separated-perfectoid-map), so (X_i)_ét,qc,sep are full subcategories stable under base change and the 2-colimit is the full subcategory of 2-colim (X_i)_ét,qcqs on separated objects (P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories, API fullSubcategory); full faithfulness follows from P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent.
2. Essential surjectivity: a quasicompact separated étale Y → X is the base change of a qcqs étale Y_i → X_i (P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent), and Y_j → X_j is separated for some j (P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage).

**Uses.**

- ECD proof of Proposition 9.7: separated étale spaces with descent data over an affinoid pro-étale limit come from a finite stage
- PerfectoidSpaces:P5/finite-stage-descent-of-qcqs-etale-objects: prerequisite of: Finite-stage descent along cofiltered limits of affinoid perfectoid spaces (ECD Proposition 6.4 (i)–(iii))

**Acceptance.**

- ECD proof of Proposition 9.7 and DiamondsAndVStacks:D3/etale-and-finite-etale-are-v-stacks: a quasicompact separated étale space with descent data over an affinoid pro-étale limit comes from a finite stage together with its descent datum.
- The glued non-separated space of P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage becomes separated after enlarging the stage.

**Prerequisites.** [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent`](#p5-qcqs-etale-finite-stage-descent), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage`](#p5-separatedness-recognition-at-finite-stage), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P5/filtered-two-colimit-of-categories`](#p5-filtered-two-colimit-of-categories), [`PerfectoidSpaces:P4/separated-perfectoid-map`](#p4-separated-perfectoid-map).
